description: Turn text into embeddings without giving callers the Voyage key. Embed text, or pass one JSON request to a Voyage endpoint. Start with embed and your text.
author: Serg Parf

embed.help: Get an embedding for text. Send the text, or JSON that also names a model and input_type.

args.name: text
args.help: Text to embed; JSON also accepts model and input_type

request.help: Call a Voyage /v1/ endpoint, such as rerank, with a JSON body that is sent unchanged.
